policy: Per CLEAN_PIPELINE.md and START_HERE_ZH.md, HECKTOR must declare physical pixel spacing, scanner transaxial FOV diameter, and continuous source-grid row/column coordinates of the scanner axis. Missing geometry is a HARD FAILURE — the locked circular FOV cannot be reconstructed without it.

input_axis_meaning.axis_1: axial slice index (0..143); current pipeline uses 72 = axial_center
input_axis_meaning.axis_2: source row index (0..143); no spacing metadata attached
input_axis_meaning.axis_3: source column index (0..143); no spacing metadata attached
input_axis_meaning.axis_4: channel: 0 = CT (HU), 1 = PET (SUV-like, max ~4.5-15.2 per subject)

physical_geometry_fields.source_spacing_y_mm: MISSING — HECKTOR.npz does not embed voxel spacing. The HECKTOR challenge distributes per-subject DICOM files at a partner site, but the NPZ shipped to us drops the affine. Cannot determine transaxial pixel size in mm.
physical_geometry_fields.scanner_fov_diameter_mm: MISSING — no scanner FOV in the NPZ. Required to justify which part of the 144x144 square fits inside the inscribed circular FOV.
physical_geometry_fields.scanner_axis_row_index: MISSING — no continuous scanner-axis row coordinate in the source grid.
physical_geometry_fields.scanner_axis_column_index: MISSING — no continuous scanner-axis column coordinate in the source grid.

summary: Across 6 HECKTOR central slices, 18.46%-28.06% (mean 22.34%) of PET activity lies outside the 144x144 inscribed circle.

A 90x90 square is the largest centred, same-parity square whose pixel centres fit inside the locked 128x128 circular FOV. This is a CANDIDATE transform, not a justified physical mapping, because the NPZ contains no voxel spacing or scanner FOV.
Masking the corners would discard measured activity; silently shrinking the anatomy could alter spatial resolution. Both are unacceptable without source-metadata justification.
recommended_resolution: Option A (preferred): Acquire per-subject DICOM headers (PixelSpacing, ReconstructionDiameter) for a representative HE subject to establish physical spacing + FOV. With these, the 144x144 -> inscribed-circle transform becomes physical_resample_circular_fov (an approved transform).

Option B: Acquire the HECKTOR challenge documentation listing scanner FOV + typical voxel spacing. If FOV = 600 mm and pixel spacing = 4.07 mm/px, the inscribed circle of radius 600/2/4.07 = 73.7 px fits within 144/2 = 72 px — geometric conflict requires explicit resolution.
Option C: Reject the HE dataset entirely for the clean_v1 study until physical geometry is recoverable.

next_step: Block HE ingestion until physical geometry is recovered. The clean_v1 study cannot legitimately use the HECKTOR dataset for paper-eligible reconstruction under the current geometric opaqueness. The 14/3/3 BW + 156/34/34 HE counts in subject_split.csv do NOT bypass this requirement.
